title: Purge the bubble, preserve the sample
instruction: Lift the needle-free syringe by its barrel, tip its nozzle upward and wait for the white air pocket to reach the nozzle. Hold the barrel with one arm while the other gently advances the blue plunger to expel the air. Leave at most 0.05 mL air and lose at most 0.30 mL sample. Do not pull the plunger back. Return the syringe horizontally to the two white saddles, open both grippers and withdraw.
setup: Two YAM arms with parallel grippers at the standard station (tabletop z=0.7475 m). A free needle-free syringe starts horizontal along +Y at barrel origin (0.25, 0, 0.8875) m: transparent rigid barrel 88 mm long, 18.6 mm outer diameter, 15 mm bore; 19 mm outlet, white flange and 85 mm stem, blue 35 x 8 x 30 mm thumb plate. Contents: 10.5 mL simulated sample and 1.5 mL air. Two white 150 mm-high rigid saddle supports on a blue 100 x 140 x 4 mm base support the barrel; a white rigid 140 x 120 x 8 mm catch tray is centred at (0.31, 0.16) m. Materials are visual proxies; geometry, masses and friction are specified in task.py. Seed 1, zero object jitter.
scoring: Final-state score requires a previous lift of barrel origin above tabletop+190 mm, return within 25 mm of start XY and 125-155 mm above tabletop, axis |z|<0.15 and y>0.985, linear speed<25 mm/s, and all fingertips >65 mm from both grasp and thumb-plate points. 1.0: air<=0.05 mL and sample loss<=0.30 mL; otherwise 0.6: air<=0.30 mL and loss<=0.50 mL; otherwise 0.3: air<=0.75 mL and loss<=0.50 mL; otherwise 0.0. Persistent failure (score 0): barrel below tabletop+15 mm or >350 mm from initial XY, sample loss>0.50 mL, aspiration>0.20 mL, or invalid fluid inputs. Success must hold for 1 second.
fidelity: The barrel and plunger are a free PhysX articulation. The coalesced air pocket and sample follow a reduced-order volume-conserving model, not CFD. No viscosity, breakup, surface adhesion or clinical-dose claims. Passive seal is an uncalibrated bounded elastic/sliding model (0.6 N maximum force); it never sets piston position.
scores: Scripted full return-to-rack demo: 1.0 (syringe-seal-v16, seed 1); no-action, horizontal-push and excessive-push controls: 0.0. Dream-1 not run.
context: Air removal before laboratory dispensing requires coordinating syringe orientation and plunger travel while limiting sample loss. Two free arms perform the operation and return the needle-free syringe to its rack.
reset_notes: Start a fresh process for each independent trial to restore the syringe, plunger, 10.5 mL sample, 1.5 mL air and failure flags.
